# SQL fixtures

`clinic.sql` is a synthetic schema script (a table, a view with TOP 20, a procedure that sets two flags, a trigger
and a function that casts to two characters), written by hand for this repository and covered by its MIT licence
(RNF-009). It is shaped like the schema scripts of the 2026-10-24 recall benchmark, but no text is copied from them.
Used by the SQL pack and the database-objects Deepen tests (P5-36). Nothing here comes from the owner's employer
(DEC-03).
